subject.title: fix(cron): mark interrupted restart runs failed instead of lost

question: Should maintainers accept the runtime-level restart recovery proof for this durable cron runningAtMs timing change, or require a full gateway stop/restart proof before merge?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix with no code finding, but it changes persisted session-state recovery timing that green CI alone does not fully settle.

options.title: Accept focused proof
options.body: Land after normal required checks if the redacted SQLite-backed runtime proof and focused regressions are sufficient for this session-state repair.

options.title: Require full gateway proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted full gateway stop/restart transcript showing the interrupted cron task becomes failed rather than lost before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept focused proof
recommendation.body: Land after normal required checks if the redacted SQLite-backed runtime proof and focused regressions are sufficient for this session-state repair.
